analyst.summary: Nazara Technologies runs a diversified portfolio of gaming, esports and ad-tech businesses and looks statistically cheap and profitable on headline numbers (a low P/E with strong return ratios). However, a large share of recent profit came from other income rather than the core business, working-capital metrics have deteriorated as the company has absorbed several acquisitions, and promoters have pledged nearly 90% of their shares -- a meaningful governance concern for existing holders. We rate this a Sell on balance.
